To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the globalization of trade, finance and investment has led to the emergence of novel problems of food insecurity and malnutrition, and that these problems can only be addressed by a radical reform of national policies in both the South and North.

food insecurity is a global problem, that the causes of food insecurity are complex, that the causes and consequences of food insecurity are linked to globalization and that public policy is required to address food insecurity.
the concept of food insecurity needs to be reconceptualized to include the problems of obesity and malnutrition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between globalization and food security.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the globalization of the world economy and the liberalization of the international trade regime has led to the development of a global food system which has had a negative impact on food security and food sovereignty in the South.
the globalization of the world's food system has led to a new context for the analysis of food security, and the new problems of obesity and malnutrition that it has generated.

globalization and food security are inextricably linked and that, in the absence of a new global governance regime that can effectively regulate the global economy and the global environment, food security in the North and the South is likely to deteriorate in the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

globalization is a process which is creating a world of winners and losers, and that food security and public health are important elements of the debate over who wins and who loses in the global economy.
food security and globalization are linked in ways that are not yet fully understood and that this paper has sought to draw attention to some of the most important issues.
food security and globalization are linked and that the link should inform policy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in a world of globalization, we need to think of food security in new ways.
food security is a complex and multifaceted concept, and that the global food system is not working for all people in all places.
food security is a fundamental human right and a prerequisite to development.
